label: Diagram 37
caption: Diagram 37 Hearths for decorative fuel effect (DFE) and inset live fuel effect (ILFE) fires: minimum plan dimensions of non-combustible surfaces
description:
The drawing is titled "Diagram 37 Hearths for decorative fuel effect (DFE) and inset live fuel effect (ILFE) fires: minimum plan dimensions of non-combustible surfaces." It contains four plan views, headed "Plan views" at the middle right of the drawing.

The top two views, captioned "Hearth projecting beyond fireplace recess," each show a grey hearth with a dashed box inside and a single 150mm horizontal dimension at the top (on the right in the left view and on the left in the right view), together with a 300mm vertical dimension above the box; the left box is labelled DFE and the right ILFE. The middle left view, labelled "Hearth contained entirely within fireplace recess," shows a DFE box with a 300mm dimension above it. The bottom left view, labelled "Free-standing hearth," shows a DFE box with 300mm dimensions to the top and left, a wall drawn to the right, and a note at the bottom "Less than 300mm if hearth extends to a wall."

A key at the bottom explains: the dashed line is the "Extent of incandescent part of fire. (In some ILFE designs this may project beyond the fireplace opening)"; a solid-line corner with an arrow marks the "Perimeter of surface to be marked"; and the grey area is the "Surface to be kept free of combustible material."
